definition: Shlomo Argamon (born 1967) is an American/Israeli computer scientist and forensic linguist.
details: He is the associate provost for artificial intelligence, dean of the Graduate School of Technology, and professor of computer science at Touro University.
story: Picture an engineer at a cluttered workbench, turning a clever idea over in their hands until it finally clicks. At its heart it is a simple notion, once you strip away the fancy name. A small key that opens a much bigger door. It is one of those ideas that feels obvious only after someone shows it to you. That is Shlomo Argamon — a small key that opens a big door.
